name: Lizzie the Lovebot
source:
While our main character was 'surfing' on the web, he came across an advertisement.

A sex doll was on sale. From 100$ to FREE! 

He lost his control and bought the doll.

At the time, he didn't know how this is going to change his life.

[From [url=https://lapapilove.itch.io/lizzie-the-lovebot]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角在網上「衝浪」時，偶然看到了一則廣告。

一個性愛人偶正在促銷，價格從100美元直接降到免費！

他一時衝動，下單買下了人偶。

彼時，他還不知道，這將怎樣改變自己的人生。

[摘自[url=https://lapapilove.itch.io/lizzie-the-lovebot]Itch.io[/url]]
